title: A pip face across the hinge
description: Fold the six exterior faces and compare the printed markings.

difficulty.label: Uncalibrated
difficulty.basis: Track an ordered corner and transport the orientation of individual motifs.

question: The net is shown from the printed side. Place that side down before folding upward, so the markings face outward. The left image shows a cube with different patterns on its six faces from a particular viewing angle. The options are nets of the cube, which are folded upward to form the cube. Which net, when folded, CANNOT form the cube shown in the left image? Please choose from options A, B, C, or D.

answer.explanation: The face order matches. The top face from 2-pip face (column 1, row 2 from the upper left) would need an extra 90 degree counterclockwise turn to reproduce the view.

options.label: A
options.explanation: Reading the net from its upper left, the top, left and right faces come from 2-pip face (column 1, row 2 from the upper left), then 4-pip face (column 3, row 3 from the upper left), then 1-pip face (column 2, row 2 from the upper left). All three markings retain the pictured orientation.
